Product Inventory Manager using STL
Problem Statement:
You are required to design a Product Inventory Manager using STL containers.
🔹 Requirements
1️⃣ Read number of products n.
2️⃣ For each product, input:
product_name price
3️⃣ Store data using:
unordered_map<string, int> → to map product name to price
set<string> → to maintain unique product names (sorted automatically)
priority_queue<int> → to find highest price quickly
🔹 Perform Operations
After input:
Display all product names in alphabetical order (using set)
Display the most expensive product price (using priority_queue)
Count how many products cost more than 1000 (using algorithm)
If duplicate product name is entered → update price
🔹 Output Format
Products (sorted): <names>
Highest Price: <value>
Products above 1000: <count>
